analysis.title: Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corp. (ZWS): 3Q26 First Take: 3Q modest adj. EBITDA beat and raise
key_insights: ZWS reported 3Q26 adj. EBITDA of $140mn, +2% vs GS and +1% vs VA consensus. Sales of $495mn were in line with VA consensus ($493mn) and +2% vs GS ($487mn).
Adj. EBITDA margin was 28.3%, about 25bps above consensus (28.1%) and 28.2% GS estimate, up from 26.9% in 3Q25.
Core organic growth was +7%, in line with the GS estimate of +7%.
Net leverage was 0.4x, helped by 3Q26 FCF of $110mn.

4Q26 adj. EBITDA guidance is $120mn-$123mn, about +2% at the mid-point vs VA consensus of $119mn (GS consensus reference $116mn). Management described the 4Q assumptions as conservative given the macro backdrop.
4Q26 sales guidance is $430mn-$437mn vs GS/VA consensus of $432mn/$438mn.
Recurring diluted EPS was $0.52 vs GS $0.50 and VA consensus $0.50, up from $0.44 in 3Q25.
GS expects the shares to respond positively on 28 October given the modest beat and raise. Rating is Neutral with a $51 12-month price target (3.8% upside from $49.15).

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Neutral with a $51 target based on 16.0x its Q5-Q8 EBITDA estimate. The firm calls 3Q a modest adj. EBITDA beat and raise and expects shares to react accordingly.

earnings_insights: ZWS 3Q26 adj. EBITDA actual (reported 10/27): $140mn vs GS est $137mn and VA consensus $138mn (+2%/+1%). 3Q25 was $122mn.
ZWS 3Q26 revenue actual (reported 10/27): $495mn vs GS est $487mn and VA consensus $493mn, +9% y/y vs GS +7% and VA +8%.
ZWS 3Q26 recurring diluted EPS actual (reported 10/27): $0.52 vs GS est $0.50 and VA consensus $0.50, vs $0.44 in 3Q25.
ZWS 3Q26 adj. EBITDA margin actual: 28.3% vs GS est 28.2% and VA consensus 28.1%.
ZWS 3Q26 core organic growth actual: +7%, vs GS est +7%.
ZWS 4Q26 company guidance: sales $430mn-$437mn (GS cons $432mn, VA cons $438mn) and adj. EBITDA $120mn-$123mn (GS cons $116mn, VA cons $119mn).
GS FY estimates: 12/26E revenue $1,842.5mn, EBITDA $504.7mn, EPS $1.81. 12/27E revenue $1,930.0mn, EBITDA $534.6mn, EPS $1.95.
risk_factors: Upside risks: non-residential construction accelerates, stronger pricing or incremental margins.
Downside risks: commercial demand decelerates materially, unfavorable M&A.
